youtube.description: 第29天雨夜，藥瓶摔碎在地上，建業站在門口說：「老太太失蹤，份歸繼承。」她上前一步：這間房子從來就不在沈家集團名下。蘇曉在線上調出電子謄本、投在藥局的白牆上，光打在建業臉上：所有權人沈月棠，單獨所有。她說老太太只是失蹤，還輪不到誰來繼承；跟進來的高經理臉比建業還白，撂下一句「這筆帳盛通會找你算」就走，建業也只能走。打烊後，知遠關上後廚的門，再問一次冬日湯的方子她怎麼會；她背對著他，唸出只有太奶奶會唸的口訣。知遠記得那是太奶奶哄他睡覺時唸的，眼睛紅了。第30天下午，林美鳳帶著錢老闆提來一只舊樟木箱，說是老太太的遺物要賣；最上面是一本民國三十七年的帳本。她伸手要，林美鳳笑著開價一百萬，知遠從後廚走出來，從褲袋掏出存摺。

data.prompt: Inside the small old pharmacy on a sunny afternoon under the fluorescent lights, seen from behind the counter toward the glass front door; the small counter lamp and a young woman's back in a white coat in the foreground. Outside under the eaves about ten old customers queue, out of focus, in the slanting afternoon sun. Lin Meifeng in her wine-red knit dress and pearl necklace pushes the glass door open; Boss Qian in his olive-green satin Chinese jacket follows with an old camphorwood chest, dark brown with brass clasps, in both arms, struggling. She holds the door for him; he sets the chest down hard on the counter and catches his breath; she brushes the dust off her hands. Lin Meifeng speaks a Mandarin line, her lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable, smiling, drawling. Everyone else keeps their mouth closed.

lines.speaker: qianlaoban
lines.text: 就最上面這本，是民國三十七年的老帳。

data.prompt: Inside the small old pharmacy on a sunny afternoon under the fluorescent lights, at the counter. Two people: on the left Boss Qian, a thick gold watch and a jade thumb ring on his right hand, flips open the brass clasps of the camphorwood chest and lifts the lid; on the right Lin Meifeng keeps one hand on the edge of the lid. Inside are folded old clothes, and on top a thread-bound ledger. Boss Qian lifts the lid, points at the ledger on top, looks up at someone across the counter and gives a dry laugh. Boss Qian speaks a Mandarin line, his lips, jaw and cheeks moving clearly with every syllable, with a dry laugh, haggling. Lin Meifeng keeps her mouth closed.
